story.value: Plutonium was first produced by Glenn T. Seaborg, Joseph W. Kennedy, Edward M. McMillan and Arthur C. Wohl.
Seaborg first considered the name plutium, but later thought it did not sound as good as plutonium.

uses.value: A form of plutonium has been used to power things such as instruments left on the Moon by Apollo astronauts and weather satellites.
Plutonium can be used to make a fuel called MOX for nuclear power reactors.
A form of plutonium was once used to power artificial heart pacemakers, but it has been replaced by lithium-based cells.
